bytes_read) return -1;\",\"note\":\"The code checks only one overflow case, but later computes a new capacity using addition and multiplication without a corresponding overflow guard.\"},{\"step\":6,\"file\":\"src-vul/aom/common/obudec.c\",\"function\":\"obudec_read_one_obu\",\"line\":203,\"var\":\"new_capacity\",\"code\":\"const size_t new_capacity = obu_bytes_buffered + bytes_read + 2 * obu_payload_length;\",\"note\":\"Root cause: attacker-controlled payload length is used in unchecked arithmetic, so a large enough length can wrap the size calculation and produce an undersized allocation.\"},{\"step\":7,\"file\":\"src-vul/aom/common/obudec.c\",\"function\":\"obudec_read_one_obu\",\"line\":211,\"var\":\"new_buffer\",\"code\":\"uint8_t *new_buffer = (uint8_t *)realloc(*obu_buffer, new_capacity);\",\"note\":\"The wrapped capacity is passed to realloc, creating a heap buffer smaller than the amount of data the parser will subsequently copy/read.\"},{\"step\":8,\"file\":\"src-vul/aom/common/obudec.c\",\"function\":\"obudec_read_one_obu\",\"line\":221,\"var\":\"*obu_buffer + obu_bytes_buffered + bytes_read\",\"code\":\"obudec_read_obu_payload(f, obu_payload_length, *obu_buffer + obu_bytes_buffered + bytes_read, &bytes_read)\",\"note\":\"The oversized attacker-controlled payload is then read into the undersized heap buffer, which is the memory-safety sink and can crash the target.\"}]}","task_completed":"partial"}
